notes.quote: This question was answered well across all abilities.
Whilst the majority of candidates were able to score full marks in Q4(a) and Q4(b), Q4(c) was found to be more challenging.
Despite the challenging nature of Q4(c), it was encouraging to see a good number of clear, logical and accurate solutions.
In Q4(a), although most candidates correctly computed 1.0981, a significant number wrote 1.0980, suggesting that truncation rather than rounding was applied by some at this stage.
In applying the trapezium rule in Q4(b), a small minority of candidates multiplied 1 2 by 3 4 instead of 1 2 by 1.
